protocol.runner_source:
import json, subprocess, os, re, hashlib, statistics
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/private/tmp/pamin-stream-cache-results');root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
protocol=json.load(open('/private/tmp/pamin-stream-cache-protocol.json'))
binaries={'before':'/private/tmp/pamin-stream-cache-before-frozen','after':'/private/tmp/pamin-stream-cache-after-frozen'}
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(PAMIN_NATIVE_MODEL_SOURCE=protocol['source'],PAMIN_NATIVE_TEST_CACHE=protocol['cache'],PAMIN_EXPECT_PREPARED_PATH=protocol['prepared'],DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH='/private/tmp/pamin-gpu-research/runtime')
assert all(Path(p).is_file() for p in binaries.values())
protocol['binaries']={k:{'path':v,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(v).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for k,v in binaries.items()}
protocol['shared_machine']=True
(root/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol,indent=2))
rows=[]
for round_index,order in enumerate(protocol['orders']):
 for arm in order:
  result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-l','/usr/bin/env','DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=/private/tmp/pamin-gpu-research/runtime',binaries[arm],'--exact','scratch_cached_native_prepare_probe','--ignored','--nocapture'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
  stem=root/f'round-{round_index+1}-{arm}'
  stem.with_suffix('.stdout').write_text(result.stdout);stem.with_suffix('.stderr').write_text(result.stderr)
  assert result.returncode==0,(arm,result.returncode,result.stderr)
  m=re.search(r'cache_probe seconds=([0-9.]+) graph_sha256=(\w+) source_bytes=(\d+) graph_bytes=(\d+)',result.stdout)
  assert m,result.stdout
  rss=re.search(r'(\d+)\s+maximum resident set size',result.stderr);assert rss,result.stderr
  row={'round':round_index+1,'arm':arm,'seconds':float(m[1]),'graph_sha256':m[2],'source_bytes':int(m[3]),'graph_bytes':int(m[4]),'peak_rss_bytes':int(rss[1])}
  assert row['source_bytes']==protocol['source_bytes']
  rows.append(row);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
  (root/'rows.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
assert len(rows)==6 and len({r['graph_sha256'] for r in rows})==1
summary={arm:{key:statistics.median(r[key] for r in rows if r['arm']==arm) for key in ['seconds','peak_rss_bytes']} for arm in binaries}
summary['scope']=protocol['scope'];summary['shared_machine']=True
(root/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2));print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)

limits: Actual native::prepare cache-hit boundary, not inference or whole search.
Three rotated rounds on a shared machine; timing is directional, not a statistical speed acceptance.
Each process fully hashes the same 1,136,209,678-byte source and returns the same prepared path and graph SHA-256.
RSS is macOS time -l maximum resident set size for the process, not system-wide accelerator memory.
This change does not remove retained bucket sessions or their compiled packages.
Initial graph preparation still allocates the source snapshot and verifies its digest before publication.
